description: Facebook 584 — 98 patches with Vietnamese UI, Following feed by default, save photos by default + hide tab bar on the Reels tab (on by default; hiding gives the bar's space back, a tap or swipe brings it back for three seconds) + experimental: push the video to the top when comments open (settings > Comments) + split the screen half and half when comments open on Reels, FIXED in 0.17.5 (0.17.4 capped only the ratio and changed nothing on a phone; 0.17.5 also caps the sheet's pixel sizes where they are worked out; on by default, settings > Comments) + the 0.17.4 switches now have Vietnamese names and summaries + tab bar background more transparent, about half of Facebook's own alpha (on by default, settings > Appearance); quiet preset.
